items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hen Gates, Jimmy’s piano player, went with Dizzy.

ctx.x: Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis, oh he was from Philadelphia too, incidentally. These people came through and played with this house rhythm section, and that’s when Howard McGhee had said, well he had known of Jimmy’s Big Band around town because Jimmy had a lot of people in his Big Band that were, they fed into Dizzy’s Big Band later. Jimmy himself, and Coltrane, John Coltrane, Benny Golson. Nelson Boyd went from Jimmy’s band to play the bass in Dizzy’s band and Hen Gates, Jimmy’s piano player, went with Dizzy. So,…
